Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 49, "heading": "CHAPTER 47. MARTHA", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 47, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u049-h", "tag": "h2", "role": "heading", "text": "CHAPTER 47. MARTHA", "sha256": "579e7259d5460dd4563151fdac4bda1d3e1dc6db100dbee817cea76e388e1cde", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/h2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0001", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We were now down in Westminster. We had turned back to follow her, having encountered her coming towards us; and Westminster Abbey was the point at which she passed from the lights and noise of the leading streets. She proceeded so quickly, when she got free of the two currents of passengers setting towards and from the bridge, that, between this and the advance she had of us when she struck off, we were in the narrow water-side street by Millbank before we came up with her. At that moment she crossed the road, as if to avoid the footsteps that she heard so close behind; and, without looking back, passed on even more rapidly.", "sha256": "e5e1c2e814930d941611358b9a1dcd04ed08983eeb1b5750d98eb3780c10c5b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[1]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0002", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A glimpse of the river through a dull gateway, where some waggons were housed for the night, seemed to arrest my feet. I touched my companion without speaking, and we both forbore to cross after her, and both followed on that opposite side of the way; keeping as quietly as we could in the shadow of the houses, but keeping very near her.", "sha256": "9ea76d51b069bfe5c396163f509be2931ed771fe63384863df01957043592a83", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[2]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0003", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There was, and is when I write, at the end of that low-lying street, a dilapidated little wooden building, probably an obsolete old ferry-house. Its position is just at that point where the street ceases, and the road begins to lie between a row of houses and the river. As soon as she came here, and saw the water, she stopped as if she had come to her destination; and presently went slowly along by the brink of the river, looking intently at it.", "sha256": "afa56044a1aea08923dbcd2a70f6c25ddf42427f5b5c27a28d735d70bc4167b5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[3]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0004", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "All the way here, I had supposed that she was going to some house; indeed, I had vaguely entertained the hope that the house might be in some way associated with the lost girl. But that one dark glimpse of the river, through the gateway, had instinctively prepared me for her going no farther.", "sha256": "848176787facefb3cd56e6af4b7fc839088b8f025cc73b77fcefbc604f893538", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[4]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0005", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The neighbourhood was a dreary one at that time; as oppressive, sad, and solitary by night, as any about London. There were neither wharves nor houses on the melancholy waste of road near the great blank Prison. A sluggish ditch deposited its mud at the prison walls. Coarse grass and rank weeds straggled over all the marshy land in the vicinity. In one part, carcases of houses, inauspiciously begun and never finished, rotted away. In another, the ground was cumbered with rusty iron monsters of steam-boilers, wheels, cranks, pipes, furnaces, paddles, anchors, diving-bells, windmill-sails, and I know not what strange objects, accumulated by some speculator, and grovelling in the dust, underneath which—having sunk into the soil of their own weight in wet weather—they had the appearance of vainly trying to hide themselves. The clash and glare of sundry fiery Works upon the river-side, arose by night to disturb everything except the heavy and unbroken smoke that poured out of their chimneys. Slimy gaps and causeways, winding among old wooden piles, with a sickly substance clinging to the latter, like green hair, and the rags of last year’s handbills offering rewards for drowned men fluttering above high-water mark, led down through the ooze and slush to the ebb-tide. There was a story that one of the pits dug for the dead in the time of the Great Plague was hereabout; and a blighting influence seemed to have proceeded from it over the whole place. Or else it looked as if it had gradually decomposed into that nightmare condition, out of the overflowings of the polluted stream.", "sha256": "a9d795fbffe970b718f40f28ed3746063a572dbb287d18ee56daed417395301b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[5]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0006", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As if she were a part of the refuse it had cast out, and left to corruption and decay, the girl we had followed strayed down to the river’s brink, and stood in the midst of this night-picture, lonely and still, looking at the water.", "sha256": "f6779e955f154f5d6d81d95acf94ac2e8e1bb3b470ed0b3a7c908311cadca487", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[6]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0007", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There were some boats and barges astrand in the mud, and these enabled us to come within a few yards of her without being seen. I then signed to Mr. Peggotty to remain where he was, and emerged from their shade to speak to her. I did not approach her solitary figure without trembling; for this gloomy end to her determined walk, and the way in which she stood, almost within the cavernous shadow of the iron bridge, looking at the lights crookedly reflected in the strong tide, inspired a dread within me.", "sha256": "84f58a1f2dd11eb6097d143efd694bd05f175ea7d7847a64c5f681369b100e78", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[7]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0008", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I think she was talking to herself. I am sure, although absorbed in gazing at the water, that her shawl was off her shoulders, and that she was muffling her hands in it, in an unsettled and bewildered way, more like the action of a sleep-walker than a waking person. I know, and never can forget, that there was that in her wild manner which gave me no assurance but that she would sink before my eyes, until I had her arm within my grasp.", "sha256": "0bb80d5080dc8ecddaa1caf5efc8b38b265251b30ab2996fbad38f6e72da871b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[8]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0009", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "At the same moment I said ‘Martha!’", "sha256": "3fc7f6f711778b168a86c5577a1701b91e0dcc3c2e4042ffc09d972ce5637a0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[9]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0010", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She uttered a terrified scream, and struggled with me with such strength that I doubt if I could have held her alone. But a stronger hand than mine was laid upon her; and when she raised her frightened eyes and saw whose it was, she made but one more effort and dropped down between us. We carried her away from the water to where there were some dry stones, and there laid her down, crying and moaning. In a little while she sat among the stones, holding her wretched head with both her hands.", "sha256": "b2543788b80c90a3e9de62e623b288c7705c844fc52d47e0477abde324ca77e7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[10]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0011", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, the river!’ she cried passionately. ‘Oh, the river!’", "sha256": "79d1c5f0efc9f348ddcfc1780222ff74bf022d36507d000c2a6673033bae82a1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[11]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0012", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Hush, hush!’ said I. ‘Calm yourself.’", "sha256": "3de9ee92db231d2d38fb201074a59cac700ad7aa630452677c71dd9a3617b73b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[12]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0013", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But she still repeated the same words, continually exclaiming, ‘Oh, the river!’ over and over again.", "sha256": "bc0b1774b578c8bbc2d5d3f3a05f1ad95c65dd6522f324887d58cdeca8832a6d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[13]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0014", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know it’s like me!’ she exclaimed. ‘I know that I belong to it. I know that it’s the natural company of such as I am! It comes from country places, where there was once no harm in it—and it creeps through the dismal streets, defiled and miserable—and it goes away, like my life, to a great sea, that is always troubled—and I feel that I must go with it!’ I have never known what despair was, except in the tone of those words.", "sha256": "9d8a1bdb378aa7e0b1f7e24aad28212b457940db209f71fe812a9c6cfe64c1a3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[14]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0015", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I can’t keep away from it. I can’t forget it. It haunts me day and night. It’s the only thing in all the world that I am fit for, or that’s fit for me. Oh, the dreadful river!’", "sha256": "bdb5735666c47141680fad46df01df45771356872da0e776949fe34fa7075126", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[15]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0016", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The thought passed through my mind that in the face of my companion, as he looked upon her without speech or motion, I might have read his niece’s history, if I had known nothing of it. I never saw, in any painting or reality, horror and compassion so impressively blended. He shook as if he would have fallen; and his hand—I touched it with my own, for his appearance alarmed me—was deadly cold.", "sha256": "b15c02f4faf99f48634bc77f47cc617598de2fcd53289b966b093e7749359285", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[16]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0017", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She is in a state of frenzy,’ I whispered to him. ‘She will speak differently in a little time.’", "sha256": "38f1757f66c251be0b8ee2bf653b5d474eebe23f328be12ed9b9be2ff2df1562", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[17]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0018", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I don’t know what he would have said in answer. He made some motion with his mouth, and seemed to think he had spoken; but he had only pointed to her with his outstretched hand.", "sha256": "f189ba51298516f103c2801e07b716a60d0308010c19542a506b61c661a29a7e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[18]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0019", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A new burst of crying came upon her now, in which she once more hid her face among the stones, and lay before us, a prostrate image of humiliation and ruin. Knowing that this state must pass, before we could speak to her with any hope, I ventured to restrain him when he would have raised her, and we stood by in silence until she became more tranquil.", "sha256": "5d789eef0a7092c55043471e2aea6df31f2ea28ba874b2223b273e0fbb9b4ba8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[19]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0020", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Martha,’ said I then, leaning down, and helping her to rise—she seemed to want to rise as if with the intention of going away, but she was weak, and leaned against a boat. ‘Do you know who this is, who is with me?’", "sha256": "5d162b377787f2d6c3c99b447737c7c9fc323cec5484a7253311c58a6eb12d30", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[20]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0021", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She said faintly, ‘Yes.’", "sha256": "27db40ead1e543f53d61dd15efb38a4e12e1e11b9aba3a93ebfc059bde2bde76", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[22]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0022", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do you know that we have followed you a long way tonight?’", "sha256": "2f202e83b4e1d04ac6c87f845a3929536a73a8b116af029a44c58311a2a084b0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[23]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0023", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She shook her head. She looked neither at him nor at me, but stood in a humble attitude, holding her bonnet and shawl in one hand, without appearing conscious of them, and pressing the other, clenched, against her forehead.", "sha256": "26440a411a4ce72bbec7f73eacde55b31bacfe84b733cf4f8774fd0d8e022207", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[24]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0024", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Are you composed enough,’ said I, ‘to speak on the subject which so interested you—I hope Heaven may remember it!—that snowy night?’", "sha256": "c441c8c23ff7d6c50b5139cf64edc1ecc2aa25d5b757641f966e146656c864a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[25]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0025", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Her sobs broke out afresh, and she murmured some inarticulate thanks to me for not having driven her away from the door.", "sha256": "bfd7e31c5817fe4ae18a772f056575e2cae272a1a4a5def1ba9e610f6732d2b7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[26]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0026", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I want to say nothing for myself,’ she said, after a few moments. ‘I am bad, I am lost. I have no hope at all. But tell him, sir,’ she had shrunk away from him, ‘if you don’t feel too hard to me to do it, that I never was in any way the cause of his misfortune.’ ‘It has never been attributed to you,’ I returned, earnestly responding to her earnestness.", "sha256": "95853c323a2ee1086d6f103b3a8be85715ddc4699e44003e1d20ad9b77da6641", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[27]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0027", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It was you, if I don’t deceive myself,’ she said, in a broken voice, ‘that came into the kitchen, the night she took such pity on me; was so gentle to me; didn’t shrink away from me like all the rest, and gave me such kind help! Was it you, sir?’", "sha256": "0a848cdb1f4896377b1b93964d1ce96057f19e516d78b1d5ab7097d98e4fc123", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[28]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0028", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It was,’ said I.", "sha256": "49c51357a2f7254e09b39474d38335e9003487e0991c192a4c7822339736253f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[29]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I should have been in the river long ago,’ she said, glancing at it with a terrible expression, ‘if any wrong to her had been upon my mind. I never could have kept out of it a single winter’s night, if I had not been free of any share in that!’", "sha256": "8127707c1b9aeb7a16e9a3b0a4173451dda8e0934372e109538243c380f3c4f4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The cause of her flight is too well understood,’ I said. ‘You are innocent of any part in it, we thoroughly believe,—we know.’", "sha256": "ede731071d7987f22eb8f2e8ba712fdc8753d5da80a9a6fc86b4915cbf1a0458", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u049-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, I might have been much the better for her, if I had had a better heart!’ exclaimed the girl, with most forlorn regret; ‘for she was always good to me! She never spoke a word to me but what was pleasant and right. Is it likely I would try to make her what I am myself, knowing what I am myself, so well? When I lost everything that makes life dear, the worst of all my thoughts was that I was parted for ever from her!’", "sha256": "bd60c5b5062850f4b5f932903ae7cb099912335e972d9300baf07e54bcbb2841", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[54]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
